connectors.name: Bottom-left 4-pin connector (G/3V3/TX/RX)
connectors.orderNote: No printed pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (right end, next to the centre USB).

connectors.name: Bottom-right 4-pin connector (G/3V3/SDA/SCL)
connectors.orderNote: No printed pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (left end, next to the centre USB).

notes: Only the two 4-pin connectors on the bottom edge have per-pin labels (printed below each connector). The centre JST-GH connector is a battery connector marked only -/+ and is skipped (rule 1). The callouts SDA: IO01 SCL:IO02 and BAT ADC INT: IO47 near the JST-GH label are not tied to individual connector pins and were not merged in. Module/peripheral GPIO tables (camera, LCD, TF card, audio) do not describe external wiring points. The LCD inset shows two small connectors whose silkscreen is too small to read; skipped.
uncertain: Per-pin labels are printed as a text row under each connector rather than beside each contact; one label per contact in left-to-right order was assumed.
The image says QWIIC x 2, but the left connector is labelled G/3V3/TX/RX; whether both connectors are QWIIC-type is not settled by the image.
